requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic request model that accepts a list of provider identifiers (NPIs or internal IDs).
The system must enforce that the request contains at least two provider identifiers.
The system must validate that each provider identifier is a non-empty string.
The system must define a Pydantic response model containing a ranked list of providers.
The system must include a numeric overall score for each provider in the response model.
The system must include a structured measure breakdown per provider in the response model.
The system must include strengths and weaknesses fields for each provider in the response model.
The system must ensure the response schema is compatible with existing provider evaluation output structures from EVAL-SCORE-PROV.
The system must ensure the strengths and weaknesses fields align structurally with outputs from EVAL-EXPLAIN.
The system must include a rank field for each provider indicating relative position in the comparison.
The system must preserve input provider identifiers in the response for traceability.
The system must raise a validation error if fewer than two provider identifiers are provided.
The system must raise a validation error if any provider identifier is null or improperly formatted.
The system must allow optional metadata fields (e.g., specialty or location) without breaking schema validation.
